propositions: Normal compaction, fsck rebuild, and crash recovery each independently re-derive candidate listing, snapshot file detection, snapshot envelope construction, retired rename-back logic, and commit operations.
Three hand-rolled candidate-listing implementations and two different snapshot-detection logic paths exist across compact_txn.py, compact_rebuild.py, and compact.py.

Snapshot envelope construction and the retired rename-back rule are duplicated across compact_txn and compact_rebuild, with commented admissions of mirroring and no unified data-loss guard enforcement.
The two-arm needs-folding rule is separately implemented in compact._scan_snapshot_state and compact_trigger.ticket_needs_folding with redundant snapshot probes.

Consolidating these derivations into compact_plan.py eliminates duplication while preserving per-path crash semantics (rebuild keeps .snapshot-rebuild.bak sentinel and per-file tolerance; fold keeps abort-and-rollback journal and guard from bug e72e).
A guard construction using _offending_line must flag any second snapshot-envelope builder or retired rename-back outside compact_plan.py, allowing only marked exceptions with reasoned comments.
